title: OpenStage people, set 1
description: Fifteen people in everyday work and casual clothes, each in many poses: Aisyah, Blayne, Daryl, David, Gerry, Harold, Jacob, Kathy, Ken, Lisa, Makoa, Malina, Mei, Salma and Yusuf. The pictures were made with an AI picture service from written descriptions.
